text:
Marta V: kickoff - proposal to add `intent`, `staleness_ttl`, `hard_expiry`, and `rollback_ref` to rollout/pin metadata. goal: unify semantics across hosted/dedicated/private.

Leo H: good. enumerate allowed values for `intent`? and how runtime treats `staleness_ttl` vs `hard_expiry`?

Marta V: intent: "maintain|canary|ephemeral". semantics: maintain = long-lived unless manual revoke, canary = short trial period with auto rollback suggestion, ephemeral = very short, auto-evict. `staleness_ttl` (seconds) marks when we flip `pin_state` to `stale` but continue serving until `hard_expiry`. `rollback_ref` is an opaque pointer (variant id or fallback tag).

Ibrahim K: conflict resolution? multiple actors may pin same model-version. propose: 1) explicit-override w/ RBAC wins, 2) maintain intent > canary > ephemeral, 3) if same intent, last-write wins. log `conflict_meta`.

Leo H: storage: we should add composite index `(tenant, model, effective_hard_expiry)` and a TTL index for soft expiries. runtime keeps top-K soon-to-expire in-memory heap for preemptive cleanup.

ops-bot: impact: ~35 bytes/pin, active pins ~520k -> ~18MB extra. background backfill ~6M writes. recommend staged backfill across 48h.

Marta V: telemetry: counters: `pin.create`, `pin.update`, `pin.evict_soft`, `pin.evict_hard`, `pin.conflict`. labels: intent, owner, outcome. add alert: sudden rise in `pin.evict_hard`.

Ibrahim K: API sample:
PATCH /v1/pins/{id}
{
  "intent": "canary",
  "staleness_ttl": 3600,
  "hard_expiry": 86400,
  "rollback_ref": "variant:2026-03-21-v2",
  "pin_note": "canary for search-ranking-v2"
}

Leo H: when `staleness_ttl` triggers, runtime marks entry `stale=true` and emits trace span `pin.mark_stale`. we should preserve serving until `hard_expiry` to avoid noisy rollbacks. also auto-fill `rollback_ref` at canary creation time.

Ibrahim K: security: `rollback_ref` must be opaque, no tenant secrets. ensure audit logs capture actor, method, and reason.

Marta V: migration plan: add nullable fields, deploy control-plane to accept them, rollout clients, backfill gradual, enable conflict-policy feature-flagged, monitor for 14 days. owners: Marta schema+migration, Leo runtime+indexes, Ibrahim telemetry+alerts.

schema-bot: created ticket ARCH-9955 with checklist items.

Leo H: small example log for SRE parsing:
event=pin_evict ts=2026-03-21T16:02:03Z pin_id=pl-77 tenant=redwood model=gw-13b intent=canary reason=staleness_evicted outcome=soft_evicted actor=deploy-svc

Marta V: thanks all, I'll open the schema PR with enum names and field docs. end.
